discreteMapping.basis: All measured2019 body-shot rungs retained, projected conservatively to canonical integer magazines; Clarity endpoints normalize old display damage rounding. This is a documented local adaptation, not current exact Destiny behavior.
discreteMapping.integerRule: Require1<=roundsBefore<=canonicalBaseCapacity. after=roundsBefore-1. Above half after:1.0. Otherwise referenceAfter=ceil(40*after/capacity), integer arithmetic. Look up measured damage at that index; no interpolation between measured rungs.
discreteMapping.scalarRule: minimumMultiplier+(measuredDamage-530)*(maximumMultiplier-minimumMultiplier)/65. Normal1.121..1.256; fusion1.103..1.229. Rescales measured DAMAGE differences, not equal rank increments.
discreteMapping.oddCapacity: After-shot coordinate means first paid affected shot has roundsBefore=floor(capacity/2)+1, for odd and even capacities. This is explicitly an adaptation from the dated40-round test.
discreteMapping.lastCartridge: roundsBefore1 is a paid cartridge with after0 and maximum. Input0 has no payable cartridge: profile throws; capture returnsNONE.
discreteMapping.ambiguity: No retrieved current primary source establishes general integer formula. Dated40-round maximum plateau starts10% AFTER shot (12.5% BEFORE), whereas current Compendium says7.5% and cached Clarity only says empty. Small-mag observations differ. Projection, coordinate convention and endpoint normalization are authored adaptations of measured data, not resolved current fidelity.
